rules:
The first line contains exactly two integers n, m (3 ≤ n, m ≤ 50).

Next n lines contain the description of the table cells. Specifically, the i-th line contains m space-separated integers ai1, ai2, ..., aim. If aij equals zero, then cell (i, j) isn't good. Otherwise aij equals one. It is guaranteed that at least one cell is good. It is guaranteed that no good cell is a corner. Unique token result under retained description; generated qualification and independent oracle/audit outstanding.
